sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: TROUGH THAT CROSSED THE UPR MS VLY YESTERDAY WILL CONTINUE NE ACROSS ONT TODAY AS A SECONDARY DISTURBANCE NOW OVER SRN SK SWEEPS SE ACROSS THE DAKOTAS AND MN TO MAINTAIN PROGRESSIVE CYCLONIC FLOW OVER THE UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS. FARTHER S...LIGHT TO MODERATE WLY FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER THE CNTRL/SRN PLNS AND THE OZARKS...ON SRN FRINGE OF DAKOTAS/MN TROUGH. OVER THE SOUTHEAST...WEAK...LOOSELY ORGANIZED TROUGH WILL CONTINUE NE ACROSS THE ERN GULF CST REGION. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO THE ONT TROUGH...ATTM TRAILING SSW FROM WRN WI TO W CNTRL TX/CNTRL NM...WILL CONTINUE E/SE ACROSS THE UPR GRT LKS AND THE MID MS/LWR OH VLYS...AND S/SE ACROSS THE SRN PLNS. THIS BOUNDARY...AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AHEAD OF IT...WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SVR TSTMS THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT...MAINLY OVER THE S CNTRL STATES.

sections.title: OZARKS/ERN PORTIONS OF SRN PLNS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE /COMPARED TO RECENT DAYS/ HAS SPREAD N INTO THE OZARKS AND ERN PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLNS...WITH SFC DEW POINTS NEAR 70F AND PW AOA 1.50 INCHES. THIS MOISTURE...COUPLED WITH CONTINUING PRESENCE OF EML ASSOCIATED WITH WLY MID LVL FLOW...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SUBSTANTIAL POTENTIAL INSTABILITY ALONG/AHEAD OF SLOWLY-MOVING COLD FRONT OVER PARTS OF OK...N TX AND THE MO/AR OZARKS TODAY. WITH STRONG SFC HEATING...EXPECT AFTN SBCAPE TO RANGE FROM AROUND 3000 J/KG IN MO TO ABOVE 4000 J/KG IN N TX. SATELLITE AND MODEL DATA SUGGEST THAT FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE WEAK. BUT SFC HEATING AND FRONTAL/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY UPLIFT BENEATH DIFLUENT MID/UPR LVL FLOW SHOULD SUPPORT INTENSIFICATION OF EXISTING STORMS OVER CNTRL/SRN MO BY EARLY AFTN...AND SUBSEQUENT DEVELOPMENT S/SW INTO PARTS OF OK...AR...AND N TX DURING THE LATER AFTN AND EVE. GIVEN DEGREE OF INSTABILITY...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR DMGG WIND AND VERY LARGE HAIL. 30-40 KT W TO WNWLY DEEP SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED STORMS...INCLUDING BOTH SUPERCELLS AND MULTICELLS. THESE LIKELY WILL MERGE INTO ONE OR MORE LARGE CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS BY EVE...WITH A CONTINUING RISK FOR SVR WIND AND HAIL. WHILE THE NOCTURNAL L

sections.title: IL NEWD INTO WI/MI THIS AFTN
sections.text: A LOW CONDITIONAL RISK FOR STRONG TO SVR STORMS WILL EXIST ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER PARTS OF THE MID MS VLY AND UPR GRT LKS TODAY. SFC HEATING WILL BE MORE LIMITED RELATIVE TO POINTS FARTHER SW...CONFINED TO A NARROW CORRIDOR BETWEEN COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH OVERNIGHT CONVECTION IN IL/WI...AND NW EDGE OF CLOUD SHIELD ASSOCIATED WITH UPR SYSTEM EJECTING NEWD ACROSS THE SERN U.S. NEVERTHELESS...EVEN MODEST HEATING MAY PROVE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW STRONG STORMS AS LOW LVL UPLIFT FOCUSES ALONG FRONT/CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW IN THE PRESENCE OF 25-30 KT DEEP WSWLY SHEAR.

sections.title: CNTRL GULF CST INTO PARTS OF AL/GA/N FL THIS AFTN
sections.text: TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE/STRENGTH WITH SFC HEATING AHEAD OF WEAK UPR TROUGH EJECTING NE ACROSS REGION. AREA RAOB DATA SHOW SUGGEST LIKELIHOOD FOR STRONG INSTABILITY BY AFTN IN THE PRESENCE OF MODEST BUT STRONGER-THAN-AVERAGE WSWLY DEEP SHEAR. THIS SETUP MAY SUPPORT LINE SEGMENTS/CLUSTERS OF STORMS WITH A POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND GIVEN VERY MOIST AIR /PW AROUND 2.00 INCHES/.

sections.title: SRN CO/NE NM INTO W TX
sections.text: POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW MAY YIELD ISOLD TO SCTD HIGH-BASED TSTMS OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF S CNTRL CO/N CNTRL NM THIS AFTN. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY PROPAGATE E/SE INTO W TX THIS EVE/TNGT AS LOW LVL ELYS STRENGTHEN. HOWEVER...IT APPEARS THAT SUCH DEVELOPMENT MAY NOT OCCUR UNTIL WELL PAST PEAK HEATING...AND THAT LOW LVL MOISTURE MAY REMAIN MORE LIMITED RELATIVE TO EARLIER FCSTS. WHILE SUBSTANTIALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WILL EXIST...POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED CLUSTERS OR SUPERCELLS APPEARS LOW GIVEN LIKELY INFLUENCE OF NOCTURNALLY-ENHANCED CIN. ..CORFIDI/LEITMAN.. 06/11/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROMINENT UPPER TROUGH OVER MANITOBA WILL PROGRESS EWD INTO ONTARIO THIS PERIOD WITH AN ASSOCIATED VORTICITY MAXIMUM AND 60-70 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK MOVING THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO UPPER GREAT LAKES. MEANWHILE...A WEAKER...LOWER-LATITUDE IMPULSE WILL PROGRESS FROM THE CNTRL PLAINS THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY. FARTHER TO THE SE...UPPER TROUGH OVER THE TN VALLEY AND GULF COAST STATES WILL PHASE WITH A POLAR BRANCH IMPULSE MOVING THROUGH THE OH VALLEY...EFFECTIVELY SUPPRESSING MIDLEVEL RIDGE AXIS IN PLACE FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TO SERN ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...COLD FRONT FROM THE UPPER MIDWEST TO SRN HIGH PLAINS WILL PROGRESS EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE UPPER GREAT LAKES AND MID MS VALLEY. THE SWRN EXTENSION OF THE FRONT IS FORECAST TO BECOME QUASI-STATIONARY TODAY ACROSS WRN TX/ERN NM.

sections.title: OZARK PLATEAU/MID MS VALLEY INTO LOWER MS VALLEY/MID SOUTH
sections.text: 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION TODAY ALONG ERN EDGE OF STRONGER SRN PLAINS CAP WHERE VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES COINCIDE WITH RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE. WHILE MID AND HIGH-LEVEL WIND FIELD DECREASES WITH SWD EXTENT ACROSS THE REGION...THE COMBINATION OF MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3500 J/KG AND A ROBUST COLD POOL ASSOCIATED WITH MATURE MCS OVER SRN MO SHOULD SUSTAIN SYSTEM SEWD TODAY INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY/MID SOUTH WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SWATHS OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. ADDITIONAL OCCURRENCES OF HIGH WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH SECONDARY LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MOVING FROM THE MID MS INTO LOWER OH VALLEY.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: AS MENTIONED ABOVE...12Z SOUNDINGS SHOWED THE PRESENCE OF A STRONG CAP ASSOCIATED WITH AN EML WITH NEARLY DRY ADIABATIC LAPSE RATES...RESIDING ABOVE A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. THE RESULTANT THERMAL STRATIFICATION WILL YIELD AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS THIS AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 4000-5000 J/KG. MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A WEAK MIDLEVEL PERTURBATION ALONG THE RED RIVER WHICH WILL CONTINUE ESEWD INTO THE ARKLATEX WITH LITTLE IN THE WAY OF LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ANTICIPATED UPSTREAM OF THIS FEATURE. AS SUCH...IT APPEARS THAT STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT /AND WRN EXTENSION OF OZARK PLATEAU MCS OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/ WILL BE THE PRIMARY MECHANISMS FORCING STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. GIVEN STORM INITIATION AND SUSTENANCE...THE EXTREME INSTABILITY AND 30-35 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT INTENSE UP/DOWNDRAFTS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. WITH TIME...GROWING STORM-SCALE COLD POOLS MAY FOSTER UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS WITH THE WIND/HAIL THREAT CONTINUING INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER LOW WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES TO FOSTER A STEADY INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE TODAY WITHIN A VERY MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. AREA WSR-88D VAD DATA AND FORECAST HODOGRAPHS ACROSS WARM SECTOR EXHIBIT A UNIDIRECTIONAL OR WEAKLY VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH MODEST /20-30 KT/ DEEP...SWLY SHEAR. AS SUCH...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR LINE SEGMENTS AND MULTICELL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: MIDWEST/UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: CONVERGENCE ALONG COLD FRONT AND EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES IN COMBINATION WITH FORCING ATTENDANT TO VORTICITY MAXIMA MENTIONED IN SYNOPSIS WILL GIVE RISE TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON FROM ERN WI/NRN IL INTO LOWER MI AND IND. PERSISTENT CLOUDS ARE EXPECTED TO TEMPER THE DEGREE OF AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION...AND THE STRONGEST MID AND HIGH-LEVEL WIND FIELD WILL LAG WARM SECTOR TO THE WEST...BOTH OF WHICH WILL MODULATE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. NONETHELESS...ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING WITH A RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. ..MEAD/ROGERS.. 06/11/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LEVEL TROUGH OVER NORTHERN PLAINS CONTINUES TO LIFT SLOWLY NEWD AS SFC COLD FRONT MOVES EAST ACROSS WESTERN GREAT LAKES SWWD INTO TX. A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS IN PLACE AHEAD OF THE FRONT ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS EWD TO THE MID/LOWER MS RIVER REGION. CHANGES TO THE 1630Z OUTLOOK WERE MAINLY TO EXTEND SLIGHT RISK AND ASSOCIATED SVR PROBABILITIES SEWD AHEAD OF WELL-ORGANIZED SVR MCS OVER MID MS VALLEY AND ADJUSTMENTS BASED ON FRONTAL POSITION ACROSS SRN PLAINS. ...OZARK PLATEAU/MID MS VALLEY REGION INTO LOWER MS VALLEY/MID SOUTH... WELL-ORGANIZED SVR MCS CONTINUES TO MOVE RAPIDLY SEWD TOWARDS SRN AR/NRN MS ACCOMPANIED BY WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS. SHORT-RANGE MODEL GUIDANCE AND CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST THE SVR THREAT WILL EXTEND SEWD INTO NWRN AL/CENTRAL MS THROUGH THIS AFTN/EVENING.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: MINOR ADJUSTMENTS TO NRN EDGE OF OUTLOOK BASED ON FRONTAL LOCATION...OTHERWISE CURRENT OUTLOOK APPEARS ON TRACK. TSTMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THE 21Z-00Z TIME FRAME ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT AS DIURNAL HEATING/FRONTAL CONVERGENCE OVERCOMES CAP. DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SUGGESTS LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE PRIMARY SVR THREAT.

sections.title: WI/WRN UPPER PENINSULA OF MI
sections.text: REF MCD #1123 FOR THE SVR POTENTIAL ACROSS WI/WRN UPPER PENINSULA MI. ..BUNTING.. 06/11/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1122 AM CDT MON JUN 11 2012/

sections.title: NRN GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: ONGOING EXPANSIVE BOW-SHAPED MCS THIS EVENING OVER THE LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY INTO THE TN VALLEY IS LOCATED ON THE ERN PERIPHERY OF A STOUT PLAINS-EMANATING EML. A WELL DEVELOPED TRAILING STRATIFORM REGION AND MATURE COLD POOL WILL AID IN DRIVING THE STORMS SWD INTO A MOISTURE RICH/VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS OVER THE NRN GULF COAST STATES. SHORT TERM HIGH-RES MODEL GUIDANCE /HRRR IN PARTICULAR/ INDICATES THE STORM COMPLEX MAY REACH THE GULF COAST BY 06Z. THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE DMGG WINDS...WITH AN ADDITIONAL RISK FOR LARGE HAIL IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE STRONGER EMBEDDED UPDRAFTS WITHIN THE LINE. FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS...HAVE EXTENDED THE SLIGHT RISK FARTHER S TO THE GULF COAST.

sections.title: W-CNTRL TX NEWD INTO THE ARKLATEX
sections.text: THE SW EXTENSION OF A FRONT IS DRAPED FROM NRN AR SWWD INTO THE PERMIAN BASIN AND INTO NM. A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS /3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE/ SAMPLED BY THE 00Z/12 AREA RAOBS HAS DEVELOPED OVER THE REGION WITHIN A WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS STRONGEST INVOF THE FRONT AND ON THE ORDER OF 30-50 KTS WITH MODEST DEEP LAYER FLOW RELEGATED FARTHER S ACROSS THE I-20 CORRIDOR. AS SUCH...A CORRESPONDING RISK FOR ORGANIZED STORMS /SUPERCELLS/ IS GREATEST NEAR THE FRONT. MODELS SHOW AT LEAST ISOLD STORM CHANCES INTO THE OVERNIGHT AS THE AREA NEAR THE FRONT BECOMES THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT AS A 30 KT LLJ DEVELOPS OVER S-CNTRL TX TONIGHT.

sections.title: COASTAL GA AND NRN FL
sections.text: AN UPPER TROUGH CENTERED IN THE NERN GULF-SOUTHEAST STATES AIDED IN FOSTERING SCTD TO NUMEROUS STORMS DURING THE PAST 6 HRS. WLY MEAN FLOW HAS SERVED TO AID IN ELY STORM MOTIONS --EFFECTIVELY PUSHING AN ELONGATED STRONG-SEVERE LINE OF STORMS OFF THE SC/GA COASTS. ..SMITH/PETERS.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO EXPAND IN COVERAGE FROM PARTS OF SRN MO INTO NRN AR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS LIFT ALONG MATURE MCS COLD POOL SPREADS SOUTH INTO AN INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS OVER THESE AREAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WERE OCCURRING WITHIN SWRN FLANK OF MATURE MCS ACROSS SWRN MO THIS MORNING. THIS SYSTEM EXISTS AMIDST WELL-DEFINED DIFFLUENCE IN THE RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF MID/UPPER LEVEL JET WHILE LOW LEVEL ASCENT IS LIKELY BEING MAXIMIZED BY ISENTROPIC LIFT ON THE NOSE OF A 25-30KT WSWLY LOW LEVEL JET. BOTH SGF AND LZK MORNING SOUNDINGS DEPICT THE POTENTIAL FOR ABUNDANT SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY TO EVOLVE THROUGH THE REST OF THE MORNING AS TEMPS WARM THROUGH THE 80SF. AND..IT IS LIKELY THAT LIFT ALONG THE ADVANCING MCS COLD POOL SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO ADDITIONAL SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT. WHILE THE GREATEST INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP TO THE SOUTH OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW ACROSS NRN MO...AND CAPPING ACROSS PARTS OF OK AND WRN AR DOES INTRODUCE SOME UNCERTAINTY WITH STORM PERSISTENCE INTO THESE AREAS...LATEST TRENDS IN RADAR AND SATELLITE DATA SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN SEVERE POTENTIAL SUFFICIENT ENOUGH TO WARRANT A WATCH ACROSS THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE CHANCE FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY INCREASE ACROSS PORTIONS OF SRN IL ACROSS THE LOWER OH RIVER VALLEY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND A WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINEAR CONVECTIVE SEGMENT ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW/COLD POOL MOVING INTO SWRN IL HAS SHOWN AN INCREASE IN REFLECTIVELY...LIGHTNING STRIKES...AND COLD CLOUD TOPS OVER THE PAST HOUR. THIS ACTIVITY WAS OCCURRING WITHIN/BENEATH DIFFLUENT MID AND UPPER LEVEL FLOW WELL REMOVED FROM OF A STRONG SHORT WAVE TROUGH CROSSING THE UPPER MS VALLEY. AIR MASS AHEAD OF THE CURRENT STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE WITH TEMPS CLIMBING THROUGH THE 80S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE EXCEEDING 2000 J/KG. WEAK INHIBITION OVER SRN IL SHOULD ALSO ALLOW FOR SOME CONVECTION TO PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. MORE WIDESPREAD ORGANIZED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE LOWER OH VALLEY IS SOMEWHAT UNCERTAIN IN THE SHORT-TERM GIVEN LACK OF STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FLOW AND WEAK/AMBIGUOUS LARGER SCALE FORCING. LACK OF THESE INGREDIENTS MAY ALSO BE WHY MOST OF THE MODEL GUIDANCE SHOWS LITTLE SUPPORT FOR WIDESPREAD CONVECTION ACROSS MUCH OF THE AREA UNTIL LATER THIS AFTERNOON WHEN DEEPER ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE COLD FRONT MOVES INTO THE AREA FROM THE WEST. HOWEVER...A WATCH WILL BE NEEDED IF LATEST TRENDS WITH THE LINEAR CONVECTION CONTINUE INTO SRN IL OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON...BUT EXPECTED COVERAGE SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR LOOPS SHOW A MCV SLOWLY TRACKING EWD ACROSS THE WRN FL PANHANDLE...WHILE A LARGER-SCALE SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH PROGRESSES EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL GULF COAST. CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY INTENSIFIED WITHIN THE PAST 1-2 HRS AS STRONG HEATING HAS RESULTED IN MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 2000 J/KG. AN ADDITIONAL BAND OF PERSISTENT/REGENERATING TSTMS IS ORIENTED SW-NE ALONG A WEAK BAROCLINIC ZONE. RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IS CONTRIBUTING TO PW VALUES NEAR 1.7-2 INCHES /PER REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS/...AND WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW DMGG WIND GUSTS VIA PRECIPITATION LOADING GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY PRESENT AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. 20-30 KTS OF DEEP-LAYER SWLY FLOW WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SOME ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS PROPAGATING ACROSS THE FL PANHANDLE AND ACROSS FAR SRN GA. CURRENT EXPECTATION IS THAT THE DMGG WIND THREAT WILL REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: EXTENSIVE STRONG/SEVERE SQUALL LINE CONTINUES TO DEVELOP EWD AND WILL CROSS THE MS RIVER THIS AFTERNOON. WITH THE CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL MOVING EAST INTO SRN IL...WRN TN/KY...AND PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN AR AND NRN MS/AL...A NEW WATCH ACROSS THESE AREAS WILL BE COORDINATED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEEP CONVECTION HAS PROGRESSED THROUGH THE MAJORITY OF WW372 THROUGH THE LATE MORNING AND HAS SHOWN SOME INCREASE IN STRENGTH AND ORGANIZATION ACROSS SERN MO LAST HOUR. ENTIRE CONVECTIVE LINE WILL CONTINUE TO PROGRESS ESEWD ACROSS THE MS RIVER AND SWD INTO ECNTRL AR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WHERE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TSTMS WITH SOME CHANCE FOR HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS MAY INCREASE OVER PARTS OF NRN AND ERN WI AND PERHAPS THE WRN U.P. OF MI THROUGH LATE THIS AFTERNOON. STORM COVERAGE AND LACK OF GREATER SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED VERY CLOSE TO THE COLD FRONT MOVING INTO AREAS OF SWRN AND CNTRL WI. ASCENT ALONG THE FRONTAL ZONE SHOULD BE ENHANCED BY FAVORABLE DCVA ASSOCIATED WITH AN UPPER SHORT WAVE TROUGH DEVELOPING INTO THE REGION. PRESENCE OF PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH ACROSS WRN WI AND THE U.P. OF MI...IN CONCERT WITH ENHANCED LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE DUE TO LAKE BREEZES...MAY ALSO RESULT IN ISOLATED STORMS FORMING NEAR THIS BOUNDARY IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SURFACE TEMPS OVER MOST OF THE AREA ARE ONLY IN THE MID 70S TO AROUND 80F. AND...WITH RELATIVELY LIMITED LOW LEVEL MOISTURE...CAPE VALUES APPEAR MARGINAL TO SUPPORT MORE ROBUST AND WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT. PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH HAS ALSO RESULTED IN VEERED SURFACE WINDS AND LACK OF STRONGER CONVERGENCE ALONG THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT. THESE FACTORS SHOULD ACT TO LIMIT NUMBER OF STORMS AND THIS SCENARIO IS SUPPORTED BY RECENT HRRR AND PRIOR ENSEMBLE MODEL DATA. ANY STORMS THAT CAN PERSIST AND REALIZE MODEST EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 30-40 KT MAY EXHIBIT ROTATION AND PERHAPS LOW-TOPPED SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS. IN ADDITION TO ISOLATED GUSTY WINDS WITH THIS CONVECTION...HAIL TO AROUND AN INCH IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL ACCOMPANY QLCS SPREADING SEWD INTO WRN TN/KY...ERN AR....NRN MS...AND NWRN AL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIGOROUS DEEP CONVECTION COMPRISES MATURE LARGE SCALE BOWING SQUALL LINE FROM THE CONFLUENCE OF THE OH/MS RIVERS SWD INTO WRN TN AND THEN WWD ACROSS ERN/CNTRL AR LATE THIS AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WINDS OF 60-70 MPH HAVE OCCURRED NEAR THE APEX OF THIS SQUALL LINE...FROM NERN AR TO THE MO BOOTHEEL OVER THE PAST HOUR. EXPECT THESE CONDITIONS MAY ACCOMPANY THE STORMS NOW MOVING ACROSS THE MEMPHIS AREA. BASED ON THE LONGER-TERM LARGE SCALE MOTION OF THE SQUALL LINE AT ABOUT 40 KT...WITH A SMALL ADJUSTMENT MADE FOR POSSIBLE ACCELERATION NEAR THE APEX OF THE BOW...THE LINE WILL MOVE INTO NRN MS WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR AND TO THE EDGE OF THE WATCH IN TN/KY BY ABOUT 22Z OR 500 PM CDT. ALSO EXPECT NWRN AL TO EXPERIENCE THE AFFECTS OF THIS SQUALL LINE BETWEEN 500-600 PM CDT. ..CARBIN.. 06/11/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS IS INCREASING OVER PARTS OF W-CNTRL AND NW TX. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT HR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS FROM 20Z PLACES A DEEPENING SFC LOW NEAR SPS...WITH A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT ORIENTED SW-NE ACROSS N TX. RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES SHOW INDICATIONS OF A DEVELOPING SFC-BASED CU FIELD 40 NW MWL OCCURRING ALONG WIND SHIFT...AND ADDITIONAL TOWERING CU DEVELOPING APPROXIMATELY 30 N SJT. VERY STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING...WITH TEMPERATURES REACHING NEAR 100 F...HAS BEEN SUFFICIENT TO OVERCOME A WARM LAYER NEAR 850 MB OBSERVED IN 12Z SOUNDINGS. FORCING FOR ASCENT IS EXPECTED TO BE WEAK...BUT GIVEN THE STRONG HEATING AND CONTINUED WEAK CONVERGENCE ALONG/NEAR WIND SHIFT AND ATTENDANT DRYLINE...INITIATION OF AT LEAST ISOLATED STORMS APPEARS INCREASINGLY LIKELY. WITH MLCAPE VALUES NOW EXCEEDING 4000 J/KG IN SOME AREAS...STORMS WILL LIKELY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS...BUT STORM ORGANIZATION SHOULD BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED BY WEAK EFFECTIVE SHEAR /NEAR 20 KTS/.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THERE IS SOME POTENTIAL FOR EVENING TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PARTS OF ERN OK AND WRN AR. VERY UNSTABLE CONDITIONS ACROSS THESE AREAS WOULD SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND HIGH WINDS IF CONVECTION CAN OVERCOME CONSIDERABLE CAPPING CURRENTLY IN PLACE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PERSISTENT CONVERGENCE NEAR FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTION ACROSS NERN OK...IN CONCERT WITH VERY HOT AND LOCALLY EXTREME INSTABILITY /MLCAPE TO AT LEAST 3000 J PER KG/...MAY CONTRIBUTE TO STORM DEVELOPMENT IN THE AREA OVER THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. LATEST INDICATIONS SUGGEST THAT STORM INITIATION IS BEING INHIBITED BY 1) VERY WARM AIR ALOFT ACTING TO KEEP AIR MASS CAPPED...AND 2) LACK OF GREATER LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION. LATEST GUIDANCE PROVIDES MIXED SIGNALS ON WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT POTENTIAL WITH RAPID REFRESH INDICATING STORM INITIATION BY 00Z...NAM SHOWING LITTLE IN THE WAY OF DEVELOPMENT...AND 18Z HRRR SHOWING ONLY ISOLATED STORMS ACROSS NWRN AR AND ERN OK IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. IF STORMS CAN DEVELOP...MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY AND MODEST WLY FLOW AROUND 30KT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO SEVERE POTENTIAL WITH LARGE HAIL AND HIGH WINDS POSSIBLE. AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED AND A WATCH IS POSSIBLE IF STORM DEVELOPMENT BEGINS TO OCCUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE WARRANTED ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN AL TO NERN LA BY 2230Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF MCS IS SPREADING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 30-35KT AND IS NOW APPROACHING THE ERN-SRN PORTIONS OF WW 373. AT THIS SPEED THE STRONGEST ECHOES WILL EXIT THE WATCH SOON. WW WILL BE WARRANTED DOWNSTREAM TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS EVOLUTION. ..DARROW.. 06/11/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES WITH STORMS ACROSS WW 374.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SOMEWHAT ERRATIC STORM MOTIONS HAVE OCCURRED THUS FAR WITH THE STORM ACTIVITY ACROSS THE WRN HALF OF WW 374...AS FAIRLY STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS PER WSR-88D VADS AND WIND PROFILERS SUPPORT STORM SPLITS. THIS TREND IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THIS EVENING AS NEW STORMS DEVELOP ALONG AND INVOF INTERACTIONS ATTENDANT TO CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND THE DRY LINE AND COLD FRONT. THE TWO RIGHT MOVERS LOCATED OVER COLEMAN AND CONCHO COUNTIES PER REGIONAL RADAR DATA ARE INTERACTING WITH THE SWWD EXTENDING DRY LINE. CONVERGENCE ALONG THE DRY LINE SHOULD MAINTAIN THESE STORMS AS THEY MOVE SLOWLY SSWWD. MEANWHILE...THE ERN MOST LEFT MOVER IN STEPHENS COUNTY WAS MOVING NNEWD ALONG THE DRY LINE TOWARD THE APPROACHING COLD FRONT. THIS STORM HAS POTENTIAL FOR A LONGER LIFESPAN AS IT TRACKS INTO AN ENVIRONMENT WITH AN INFLOW OF STRONG-EXTREME INSTABILITY. IN ADDITION...TRENDS IN TCU/JTN/PRC WIND PROFILERS INDICATED AN INCREASE IN WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS /5-8 KM AGL LAYER/...RESULTING IN A SUBSEQUENT INCREASE IN BULK SHEAR INTO NRN TX. THUS...STORMS FORMING OR MOVING INTO THE NRN EXTENT OF WW 374 WILL HAVE A GREATER POTENTIAL TO MAINTAIN STORM-SCALE ORGANIZATION. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY ACROSS THE MIDDLE AND ERN PARTS OF THIS WW AND VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /AROUND 9 C PER KM/...VERY LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE. DCAPE OF 1400-2000 J/KG WITH HIGH BASED STORMS WILL FAVOR DAMAGING WINDS AS WELL. ..PETERS.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG WINDS WILL CONTINUE ALONG LEADING EDGE OF MCS AS IT SPREADS SOUTH THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED MCS CONTINUES ITS FORWARD MOTION AT ROUGHLY 30-35KT AS IT PROGRESSES INTO THE MIDDLE PORTIONS OF WW 375. STRONG OUTFLOW...WITH ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS IN EXCESS OF 50KT...WILL BE COMMON ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS COMPLEX OF STORMS. WHILE 00Z SOUNDINGS FROM SHV/JAN EXHIBIT MINOR INHIBITION...BMX HAS NO APPARENT CAP AND THIS ENTIRE REGION ALONG THE I-20 CORRIDOR IS QUITE UNSTABLE WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES. FOR THIS REASON IT APPEARS THE MCS WILL PERSIST FOR SOME TIME AND WILL LIKELY APPROACH THE SRN EDGE OF THE WATCH AROUND 0200-0230Z. ..DARROW.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS CONDUCIVE FOR A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL INTO SERN OK THIS EVENING. DEEPER MOIST CONVECTION IS TRYING TO DEVELOP ALONG THE SWD MOVING FRONT...WITH THIS TREND EXPECTED TO CONTINUE. IF VISIBLE AND RADAR IMAGERY SHOW SIGNS OF MORE SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS...THEN A WW WILL NEED TO BE COORDINATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSES AND TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A FRONT MOVING SWD THROUGH OK...AND AT 0020Z THIS BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM EAST CENTRAL TO SOUTH CENTRAL-SWRN OK. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES AND 00Z SOUNDINGS INDICATED A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS IN PLACE ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL-SERN OK WITH MLCAPE 3000-4500 J PER KG. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT IS VERY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL /GREATER THAN 2 INCH DIAMETER/ AND STRONG DAMAGING WINDS. THUS FAR...A RATHER STRONG CAP HAD INHIBITED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE FRONT THIS AFTERNOON...BUT 00Z OUN SOUNDING INDICATED THE CAP HAD WEAKENED...GREATLY REDUCING SURFACE BASED INHIBITION. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SUGGESTED WEAKENED INHIBITION ACROSS EAST CENTRAL TO SERN OK...WHERE RECENT TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED A MORE SUSTAINED UPDRAFT /MCINTOSH COUNTY/ AS COMPARED TO A COUPLE OF STRUGGLING CONVECTIVE CELLS IN PONTOTOC AND CARTER COUNTIES EARLY THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONGEST STORMS WITH A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT THE PORTION OF WW 374 ACROSS WRN N TX INTO NORTH CENTRAL TX /ALONG AND S OF THE RED RIVER...NEAR AND N OF THE DFW METROPLEX/. IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...PW VALUES AT OR ABOVE 1.5 INCH WILL SUPPORT HEAVY RAINFALL RATES. THE WRN HALF OF WW 374 HAS BEEN STABILIZED...AND COULD BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO THE SCHEDULED 04Z EXPIRATION TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF STRONG-SEVERE LEFT MOVING STORMS THAT HAD TRACKED NNEWD ACROSS THROCKMORTON AND YOUNG COUNTIES RECENTLY EVOLVED INTO AN W-E ORIENTED TSTM COMPLEX EXTENDING FROM BAYLOR TO JACK/MONTAGUE COUNTIES. THIS W-E TSTM EXPANSION OCCURRED AS THE LEFT MOVERS ENCOUNTERED THE SWD MOVING COLD FRONT...WHICH AT 0225Z EXTENDED FROM LE FLORE COUNTY OK WWD TO MURRAY COUNTY...AND THEN WSWWD THROUGH CARTER COUNTY OK INTO THE AFOREMENTIONED WRN N TX TSTM COMPLEX. MEANWHILE...THERE HAS BEEN SOME INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT SWWD FROM JACK COUNTY INTO PALO PINTO COUNTY TX. MODERATE WLY MIDLEVEL FLOW INTO N TX/SRN OK WILL MAINTAIN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT. THIS COMBINED WITH RESIDUAL STRONG TO EXTREME INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 3000-4000 J PER KG/ ALONG AND EITHER SIDE OF THE RED RIVER WILL FAVOR A CONTINUED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. PWS AOA 1.5 INCH WILL ALSO SUPPORT HEAVY RAINFALL RATES ESPECIALLY WITH THE SLOWER MOVING STORMS OVER A GIVEN LOCATION. FARTHER S-SW OF THIS AREA /ACROSS THE WRN HALF OF WW 374/...THE AIR MASS HAS BEEN STABILIZED BY EARLIER CONVECTION WITH ADDITIONAL ELEVATED TSTMS LIKELY N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHICH EXTENDED NWWD FROM SRN KIMBLE COUNTY THROUGH NERN CROCKETT COUNTY TO W OF MAF. 35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS THIS AREA MAY SUPPORT A HAIL THREAT...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS PER REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS ANY STRONGER CELLS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED. ..PETERS.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MCS WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WATCH WITH A THREAT OF STRONG/ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED MCS HAS YET TO WEAKEN APPRECIABLY AS IT SPREADS SWD AT ROUGHLY 30KT...THOUGH INTENSITIES ALONG LEADING EDGE OF STRONGEST UPDRAFTS MAY BE TRENDING DOWN SOME. IN ALL LIKELIHOOD THIS COMPLEX OF STORMS SHOULD PROGRESS ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW376 AND APPROACH THE CNTRL GULF COAST AROUND 07Z. UPSTREAM...WEAK WARM ADVECTION ALONG BACK SIDE OF MCS COULD GENERATE ELEVATED CONVECTION ACROSS PARTS OF SRN AR/NRN LA LATER TONIGHT BUT IT/S NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR HOW SEVERE THESE UPDRAFTS WOULD BE. ..DARROW.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS SHOWERS/THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ACROSS SRN OK/RED RIVER REGION OF TX. MCS SHOULD SPREAD ESEWD INTO THE EARLY-MID MORNING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: COMPLEX ARRAY OF TSTMS HAS EVOLVED ALONG THE RED RIVER. MUCH OF THIS ACTIVITY DEVELOPED WITHIN INTENSE CORRIDOR OF HEATING NEAR THE SFC WIND SHIFT OVER NWRN TX BUT NUMEROUS LEFT SPLITS AND INCREASING WARM ADVECTION HAS DISPLACED THE CONVECTIVE COMPLEX INTO SRN OK. SIGNIFICANT OUTFLOW IS RACING NWD ACROSS SWRN OK AND THIS MAY AID IN FURTHER DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THE AREAL EXPANSION OBSERVED OVER THE LAST HOUR IT APPEARS AN MCS MAY BE EVOLVING THAT WITH TIME SHOULD BEGIN TO TURN/SPREAD ESEWD TOWARD THE ARKLATEX. ASIDE FROM ISOLATED LARGE HAIL HEAVY RAIN WILL BE THE GREATEST THREAT WITH THESE DEVELOPMENT STORMS. ..DARROW.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIND AND HAIL REMAIN LIKELY ACROSS WW 378...AND A THREAT MAY BE DEVELOPING ACROSS NRN LA AS WELL. A REPLACEMENT WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR NRN LA AND SRN AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LARGE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES TO EVOLVE OVER NERN TX AND SERN OK. DRIVEN BY OUTFLOW...A LINE HAS CONSOLIDATED ACROSS NERN TX INTO FAR SERN OK. A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...AND ALTHOUGH SHEAR IS WEAK...THIS SYSTEM WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE EWD THEN PERHAPS TURNING MORE SEWD WITH TIME. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY...ALTHOUGH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY OCCUR AS WELL. AHEAD OF THIS LINE...OTHER VIGOROUS STORMS WE LOCATED OVER SRN AR ALONG THE OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE LIFT IS BEING MAXIMIZED WITH WEAK SWLY LOW LEVEL FLOW. THESE CORES WILL BE CAPABLE OF HAIL...AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL IS LIKELY ALONG WITH GUSTY WINDS ACROSS ERN NM AND INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. THE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN FOCUSED IN A RELATIVELY NARROW CORRIDOR...AND MAY LAST FOR A FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CELLS WITH HAIL HAVE FORMED NEAR AN ELEVATED BOUNDARY WITH SUBTLE ISENTROPIC LIFT ABOVE 850 MB. LAPSE RATES ALOFT ARE QUITE STEEP AND THE BETTER MOISTURE IS IN CLOSE PROXIMITY. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS FAVORABLE FOR A FEW LONGER LIVED CELLS AS WELL. MODELS INDICATE THIS WWD SURGE OF THETA-E ADVECTION PEAKS BETWEEN 0900-1200Z...THEN RELAXES. THEREFORE...A FEW SEVERE HAIL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR 2-3 HOURS...BEFORE DIMINISHING LATER THIS MORNING. THE THREAT MAY PERSIST ESEWD TOWARD THE CDS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS MAINLY NRN PORTIONS OF WW 379...AND MAY EVENTUALLY MOVE INTO PORTIONS OF SWRN MS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCC CONTINUES EWD ACROSS NRN LA AND SRN AR...WITH INTENSE BOW CONTINUING EWD ACROSS NRN MS. OTHER CELLS WERE FORMING SE OF THE MAIN BOW WHERE MODEST SWLY WINDS WERE BEING LIFTED ATOP OLD OUTFLOW. AREA VWPS SHOW NLY WINDS FROM CNTRL MS INTO SERN LA...WHICH MAY HELP STORMS TO EVENTUALLY SHIFT SEWD. THIS SITUATION MAY EVOLVE OUT OF THE MERGING OF THE MAIN BOW...THE WARM ADVECTION CONVECTION OVER NERN LA...AND THE WEAK SYSTEM OVER NWRN MS. STORMS WOULD CONGEAL AND MOVE SWD WITH THE MEAN FLOW ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT WITH A WIND THREAT.
